title: VCSEL_LIV_Measurement_Schema
description: Schema for VCSEL light-current-voltage (L-I-V) and spectral telemetry curves used in parameter calibration.

current_mA.description: Injected current sweep array in milliamperes.

voltage_V.description: Measured terminal voltage array in volts.

optical_power_mW.description: Measured optical power from the top aperture in milliwatts.

wavelength_nm.description: Optional measured peak wavelength red-shift track in nanometers.

monitor_current_mA.description: Optional measured back-facet monitor current array in milliamperes.

measurement_temperature_K.description: Optional local ambient temperature of each point in Kelvin.
